_comment: Numeric ceilings and selector lists behind each rule, with a one-line why. Rules informed by Emil Kowalski's published animation guidance (see README credits).

duration_ceilings_ms._why: a control used often needs a lower cap than one used rarely, since the wait adds up across many uses of the same control

hard_max_why: beyond this length, whatever the intent was, the viewer just experiences a pause with no clear cause

kind_selectors._why: keyword hints found in the surrounding markup used to pick which ceiling applies

high_frequency_selectors._why: an interaction repeated this often turns its own animation into cumulative waiting time, so removing the motion beats trimming its length

constant_motion_selectors._why: a flat, unchanging rate only matches motion that has no start or finish to accelerate toward

loader_selectors._why: only a state with no known finish time, like a wait for a network response, calls for a loop with no stop condition
